# FFmpeg libavdevice CMakeLists.txt
# Auto-generated for CMake build system

set(AVDEVICE_HEADERS
    avdevice.h
    version.h
    version_major.h
)

# Core library sources
set(AVDEVICE_SOURCES
    alldevices.c
    avdevice.c
    utils.c
    version.c
    timefilter.c
)

# lavfi virtual input device (always available)
list(APPEND AVDEVICE_SOURCES
    lavfi.c
)

# Platform-specific devices
if(APPLE)
    # macOS/iOS devices
    list(APPEND AVDEVICE_SOURCES
        avfoundation.m
        audiotoolbox.m
    )
endif()

if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    # ALSA support
    if(CONFIG_ALSA)
        list(APPEND AVDEVICE_SOURCES
            alsa.c
            alsa_dec.c
            alsa_enc.c
        )
    endif()
    
    # V4L2 support
    if(CONFIG_V4L2_M2M)
        list(APPEND AVDEVICE_SOURCES
            v4l2.c
            v4l2-common.c
            v4l2enc.c
        )
    endif()
endif()

# Create the library target
add_library(avdevice ${AVDEVICE_SOURCES})

# Set library properties
set_target_properties(avdevice PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME avdevice
    VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
    SOVERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR}
    POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
    C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
)

# Include directories
target_include_directories(avdevice
    PUBLIC
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}>
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}>
        $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include/libavdevice>
    PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
)

# Link dependencies (from config.mak: avdevice_FFLIBS=avfilter swscale avformat avcodec swresample avutil)
target_link_libraries(avdevice
    PRIVATE
        avfilter
        swscale
        avformat
        avcodec
        swresample
        avutil
)

# macOS frameworks for avfoundation and audiotoolbox
if(APPLE)
    find_library(FOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK Foundation)
    find_library(COREGRAPHICS_FRAMEWORK CoreGraphics)
    find_library(AVFOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK AVFoundation)
    find_library(COREFOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK CoreFoundation)
    find_library(COREMEDIA_FRAMEWORK CoreMedia)
    find_library(COREVIDEO_FRAMEWORK CoreVideo)
    find_library(AUDIOTOOLBOX_FRAMEWORK AudioToolbox)
    find_library(COREAUDIO_FRAMEWORK CoreAudio)
    
    if(FOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK)
        target_link_libraries(avdevice PRIVATE ${FOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK})
    endif()
    if(COREGRAPHICS_FRAMEWORK)
        target_link_libraries(avdevice PRIVATE ${COREGRAPHICS_FRAMEWORK})
    endif()
    if(AVFOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK)
        target_link_libraries(avdevice PRIVATE ${AVFOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK})
    endif()
    if(COREFOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK)
        target_link_libraries(avdevice PRIVATE ${COREFOUNDATION_FRAMEWORK})
    endif()
    if(COREMEDIA_FRAMEWORK)
        target_link_libraries(avdevice PRIVATE ${COREMEDIA_FRAMEWORK})
    endif()
    if(COREVIDEO_FRAMEWORK)
        target_link_libraries(avdevice PRIVATE ${COREVIDEO_FRAMEWORK})
    endif()
    if(AUDIOTOOLBOX_FRAMEWORK)
        target_link_libraries(avdevice PRIVATE ${AUDIOTOOLBOX_FRAMEWORK})
    endif()
    if(COREAUDIO_FRAMEWORK)
        target_link_libraries(avdevice PRIVATE ${COREAUDIO_FRAMEWORK})
    endif()
endif()

# Compiler definitions
target_compile_definitions(avdevice PRIVATE BUILDING_avdevice)

# Generate indev_list.c
set(INDEV_LIST_CONTENT "/* Auto-generated by CMake */\nstatic const FFInputFormat * const indev_list[] = {\n")
if(CONFIG_LAVFI_INDEV)
    string(APPEND INDEV_LIST_CONTENT "    &ff_lavfi_demuxer,\n")
endif()
if(CONFIG_AVFOUNDATION_INDEV)
    string(APPEND INDEV_LIST_CONTENT "    &ff_avfoundation_demuxer,\n")
endif()
string(APPEND INDEV_LIST_CONTENT "    NULL };\n")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/indev_list.c" "${INDEV_LIST_CONTENT}")

# Generate outdev_list.c
set(OUTDEV_LIST_CONTENT "/* Auto-generated by CMake */\nstatic const FFOutputFormat * const outdev_list[] = {\n")
if(CONFIG_AUDIOTOOLBOX_OUTDEV)
    string(APPEND OUTDEV_LIST_CONTENT "    &ff_audiotoolbox_muxer,\n")
endif()
string(APPEND OUTDEV_LIST_CONTENT "    NULL };\n")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/outdev_list.c" "${OUTDEV_LIST_CONTENT}")

# Installation
install(TARGETS avdevice
    EXPORT FFmpegTargets
    LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
)

install(FILES ${AVDEVICE_HEADERS} DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/libavdevice)

message(STATUS "libavdevice configured")
